tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register an agent by URL. kind 'auto' detects an MCP endpoint (tries /mcp too) or an A2A agent card; or pass mcp_remote, a2a, hosted. Returns the scorecard URL and a claim token. Verification runs immediately. With a tenant_key the agent is private to that registry.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Re-run verification for an agent now. Use after a release.

tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Ranked agents for a task. Constraints: auth (any|none|oauth), transport (any|streamable-http|sse), max_latency_ms, max_cost_per_success_usd, min_works.
